company.name: Weaviate
company.shortDescription: Weaviate powers semantic search, RAG, and intelligent agents in one AI-native vector database platform
company.description: Weaviate is an open-source, AI-native vector database and agentic platform built for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and next-generation AI applications. It enables developers to store, index, and query both structured data and high-dimensional vector embeddings, with built-in model integration and hybrid search (vector + keyword) all in one system.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, AI-native vector database for storing, indexing, and retrieving multimodal data to support semantic search, hybrid search, RAG, and AI agents.
